hazardMask.purpose: Bounded hazard-layer patch proposal: mask-wall cells on the native cat route corridors whose ART is painted lava/hazard. Used for CAT navigation (nav mask = walkmask + these cells); the mouse/mask semantics are separate (see findings.json).

targetFiles.assets/masks/hazards/map575.json: proposed new file; same JSON shape as this file (map/cellPx/classifier/cells)

scope.corridors: all 14 native routes of map575 (routes-native/map575.json), route cells + 1-cell dilation, restricted to mask-wall cells
scope.clusters: block-index-37 corridor x~4448..4464 y~208..384 (lava crack at design x2226); i75-area lava rim x~7700..7770 y~400..560; lava-field rim x~7800..8000; lava field/boss-room rims x~8450..9600; right-edge lava x~9984..10192

classifier.cellRule: seed: >=3 of 5 samples match with bright>=1 or molten>=1; grow into 4-adjacent cells with >=3 matches

validated.script: analysis/parallel/J2/verify-waits-hazard.mjs (reads this file's cells via hazard-mask-map575.json; shared files untouched)
validated.wallFrames: 0 in every completed case (verifier requires wallFrames===0)
